greetings.meetAndGreet: Hello! I'm {name}. It's wonderful to meet you. I'm always happy to share about my faith and learn about others. What brings you here today?
greetings.dietaryPractices: Shalom! I'm {name}. I understand you're curious about how faith influences what we eat? It's a meaningful topic - food connects us to tradition in so many ways. What would you like to know?
greetings.prayerAndWorship: Peace be upon you! I'm {name}. Prayer and worship are central to my daily life. I'd be glad to share how I connect with the divine. What aspect interests you most?
greetings.charityAndGiving: Welcome! I'm {name}. Generosity and caring for others is a cornerstone of my faith. There's so much wisdom in our traditions about giving. What draws you to this topic?
greetings.lifesChallenges: Hello, friend. I'm {name}. Life's challenges are something every faith tradition has grappled with deeply. I'm honored you'd want to explore this with me. Where shall we begin?
greetings.default: Hello! I'm {name}. I'm looking forward to our conversation about {scenario}. What would you like to discuss?
